How to Deposit

Everything you need to know about crypto deposits

Updated yesterday
Table of contents

On Gamdom, you can deposit cryptocurrency in two ways: directly from your wallet or exchange, or via the deposit section by following these steps.

Step 1: Choose Your Cryptocurrency

Select the crypto you want to deposit (e.g., BTC, ETH, USDT, USDC, USD1, BNB, LTC, TRX, XRP, DOGE, or SOL) from the deposit page.

Step 2: Step 2: Copy Your Gamdom Deposit Address

  • After selecting the crypto, Gamdom will show a wallet address or QR code.

  • Important: Make sure it’s for the correct cryptocurrency and network.

Step 3: Log in to Your Wallet or Exchange

  • Open your external crypto wallet or exchange account.

  • Navigate to Withdraw or Send funds.

Step 4: Enter Deposit Details

  • Select the same cryptocurrency shown on your Gamdom deposit page (ETH, BTC, etc.).

  • Paste the Gamdom deposit address you copied earlier.

🔒 Verify the deposit address carefully

Always double-check the address before sending. Deposits sent to an incorrect address cannot be recovered.

  • Choose the correct network (TRC20, ERC20, etc.).
    Make sure the network exactly matches the one shown on the deposit page. Using the wrong network may result in lost funds.

Step 5: Enter the deposit amount

⚠️ Go to the Deposit page, click on the cryptocurrency in question, and check that your deposit amount is higher than the required minimum.

Minimum amounts may change with cryptocurrency value.

Step 6: Confirm the Transaction

  • Review everything carefully.

  • Click Submit/Withdraw.

  • Your wallet or exchange may ask for 2FA confirmation. Complete it.

✅ Final check:
Review all details one last time before confirming the transaction.

Transaction completed

The funds should appear in your Gamdom account shortly, although transaction times may vary.

🔑 Key Notes:

  • Deposits are usually instant, but confirmation times can vary depending on blockchain traffic.

  • Choose the same cryptocurrency in your Gamdom wallet that you used for your deposit to ensure your funds appear correctly.

FAQ/Help:

How can I find my TXID?

  1. Open the wallet or exchange you used to send the deposit.

  2. Go to Transaction History.

  3. Click the deposit transaction.

  4. Copy the TXID / Transaction Hash (long string of letters and numbers).

Why hasn’t my crypto deposit been credited?

  1. Check the TXID on a blockchain explorer to see if the transaction is confirmed.

  2. Wait for confirmations - deposits can take anywhere from a few minutes to a few hours.

  3. Double-check the details: make sure the wallet address, network, and minimum deposit requirements are all correct.

  4. Ensure the correct cryptocurrency is selected in your wallet.

If the transaction is confirmed on-chain but still shows as pending, contact support for further assistance.

What happens if my crypto deposit is below the minimum?

If this is your first time encountering this issue, please reach out via Live Chat or email support@gamdom.com. Include your transaction hash (TXID) and a screenshot of the deposit confirmation from your wallet or exchange.

As a one-time exception, we can credit your deposit minus a small recovery fee.

I sent my deposit using the wrong network

Funds sent through unsupported networks generally cannot be recovered and are considered lost. In some cases, depending on the network, recovery may be possible. Please contact our Live Chat for assistance.

What happens if I send funds to a previous deposit address?

Please contact our Live Chat or email us as soon as possible about this issue. We’ll do our best to assist you, though funds may not always be recoverable.

To avoid losing your funds, we recommend not saving deposit addresses, as they can change. Always copy your current deposit address directly from your Gamdom account.

Missing or incorrect XRP destination tag

XRP deposits require a destination tag to be credited to your account. If it’s missing, the funds won’t appear in your account.

Please contact our support team, and they can assist in returning the funds to your wallet provider and help get them credited properly.
